sloka: विज्ञानम् हि महत् भ्रष्टम् शाप दोषेण राघव ।स्वकृतेन मया प्राप्तम् रूपम् लोक विगर्हितम् ॥३-७१-३०॥
transliteration: vijñānam hi mahat bhraṣṭam śāpa doṣeṇa rāghava ।svakṛtena mayā prāptam rūpam loka vigarhitam ॥3-71-30॥

translations.english: Before the Sun disappears with his tired horses drop me into a pit and cremate me in accordance with tradition, O Rama
